fact: A UNITAR evaluation of May 2024 says a UNITAR project of July 2021 to July 2023 planned a pilot integrated electronic case management system in Bamako covering judiciary, prosecution and corrections, and that a Rwanda study visit led to discussion of a follow-up digitalisation project.
title: Independent Evaluation of the Strengthening the capacity of the judicial system and promoting the rule of law in Mali Phase II Project
publisher: UNITAR Planning, Performance Monitoring and Evaluation Unit
